entries.final_answer: one-kind-per-family: new PRIMARY kinds MISSION_GOALS (goals.md), OCCURRENCE_MAP (occurrence_map.yaml), RELEASE_RECORD (release.md), RESEARCH_OUTPUT (findings/report/methodology/synthesis/literature-review); reuse RESEARCH for research/ subtree (dir-anchored), ANALYSIS_REPORT for gap-analysis.md + audit-report.md, PRIMARY_METADATA for meta.json.
